title: The Personal Wellness Plan
learning_focus: Engaging in physical and other activities to improve holistic wellness; goal setting and self-monitoring.
story_premise: The Wellness Guide asks the player to design a balanced week rather than chase a perfect score in one dimension.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Engaging in physical and other activities to improve holistic wellness; goal setting and self-monitoring.

areas.title: Goal Hall
areas.story: Write a specific, realistic wellness goal. Choose movement, recreation, social, reflective, and rest activities.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Health Guide
opening_dialogue.text: A health or safety concern is affecting Goal Hall.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Health Guide
opening_dialogue.text: Write a specific, realistic wellness goal.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Health Guide
opening_dialogue.text: Observe the signs, think about Engaging in physical and other activities to improve holistic wellness, then apply the safest healthy action.

learning_clues: Health focus: Engaging in physical and other activities to improve holistic wellness.
Observe signs, context, and available trusted support before acting.

questions.prompt: What is the healthiest first response in Goal Hall?

options.text: pause, observe the situation, and choose a safe action related to Engaging in physical and other activities to improve holistic wellness
Ignore the signs and continue the unsafe behavior.
Copy another person without checking the situation.
Hide the problem and avoid trusted help.

questions.correct_feedback: The statement is true: the clues provide the reason for the healthy or safe choice.

questions.prompt: Select the two actions that support a safe and healthy decision.

options.text: Use the observed clues.
Choose a safe action or ask a trusted person for help.
Ignore warning signs.
Repeat an unsafe choice to see what happens.

questions.second_wrong_explanation: Safe decisions use evidence from the situation and appropriate help when needed.
questions.correct_feedback: Safe decisions use evidence from the situation and appropriate help when needed.

questions.prompt: What should happen after the learner answers the situation questions?

options.text: Apply the healthy action in the game world and observe the result.
Collect the symbol without helping the NPC or area.
Restart the entire mission after one mistake.
Upload the static question text to the server.

questions.first_wrong_hint: PE & Health requires an applied action, not only a quiz answer.
questions.second_wrong_explanation: The correct choice must be applied in the world so the learner sees its effect.
questions.correct_feedback: The correct choice must be applied in the world so the learner sees its effect.

areas.world_action: Apply a safe, age-appropriate action demonstrating Engaging in physical and other activities to improve holistic wellness.
areas.world_result: The NPC or environment in Goal Hall visibly improves after the healthy action.
